scrape.title: Scrape Mode
scrape.description: In Scrape mode, Javinizer-JS scans your library for video files, extracts their codes, and fetches metadata from configured scrapers. Results are saved as JSON files in data/scrape/ directory. You can then review, edit, and save them to your library with proper folder structure and NFO files.

edit.title: Edit Mode
edit.description: In Edit mode, Javinizer-JS loads existing NFO files from your library, allowing you to review and modify metadata. Changes are saved directly to the NFO files in your library folders.

actors.title: Actor Management
actors.description: Javinizer-JS can automatically scrape and cache actor data during movie save operations. Actor thumbnails and metadata are stored in data/actors/, which is the single source of truth for every actor. Mark actors as favorites on the Actors page to keep a curated shortlist and optionally copy their photo/NFO to an external folder. Actors that share a name with another record are flagged automatically and can be merged from the Actors page.

grid.title: Grid View
grid.description: Grid View shows a paginated, searchable view of your library and pending scrape results. Use the search box to filter by title, actor, or ID; an active filter is remembered as you move between Grid View and Edit mode.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Visit the Configuration page to set up your library path, enable scrapers, configure actor scraping, and customize other settings. Changes are saved automatically and take effect immediately.
